scope: Actual prototype schema preference module in Node VM. No database execution or live UI claim.

tests.name: Unset defaults exclude system schemas
String catalogs and explicit system descriptor work
Selection persists and remounts
Connection and endpoint scopes stay isolated
Explicit empty selection survives remount and discovery
Null resets to defaults; persisted null is unset
Newly discovered schemas are not added to explicit selections
Unavailable selections disappear and return when catalog returns
Set removes unknown and stale names and deduplicates in catalog order
System schema may be explicitly selected
Prototype-sensitive and Unicode scope/schema names remain literal
Result and controller snapshots are immutable and detached from input
Invalid persisted state falls back safely: {broken
Invalid persisted state falls back safely: null
Invalid persisted state falls back safely: []
Invalid persisted state falls back safely: {"version":88,"scopes":{"db":[]}}
Invalid persisted state falls back safely: {"version":1,"scopes":["wrong"]}
Invalid persisted state falls back safely: {"version":1,"scopes":{"db":[null]}}
Denied reads/writes preserve in-memory selection
Denied global storage getter does not throw
Default storage path works
Malformed input has no persistence side effects
Only selection names/scopes/version are persisted
